name: stop-that-shit
title_zh: 只准改该改的，越界一步就喊停的代码审查员
tagline_zh: 受够了 Agent 顺手加依赖、改配置、绕圈审计？它盯住你划的只读/只答/文件/动作边界，一越界立刻打断，不废话。
tagline_en: Tired of agents adding deps, tweaking configs, or looping audits? It watches your.
desc_en: Keep coding agents focused on requested and necessary work. Use when a request sets a read-only, answer-only, file, action, or stopping boundary; when evidence shows scope creep, speculative hardening, unnecessary hashing or dependencies, repeated audit loops, or valueless delegation; or when the user invokes Stop That Shit. Do not invoke for an ordinary focused fix without a boundary or scope-cre
why_zh: 不是事后总结，而是在请求里识别显式边界，用证据触发拦截——比靠提示词祈祷可靠，比人盯省心。
why_en: It doesn't summarize after the fact—it parses explicit boundaries from the request and intercepts with evidence, more reliable.
limit_zh: 只认请求里写明的边界；若任务本身模糊、没给只读/只答/文件/动作限制，它不会主动猜。不拦正常的小修小补。
limit_en: Only triggers on explicit boundaries in the request; won't guess on vague tasks, won't block ordinary focused fixes, and does no code-quality review.
title_en: A boundary enforcer that stops coding agents from scope.
